title: Logitech M215 2.4GHz Wireless Optical Mouse (no USB Receiver) – PC Laptop
categoryName: Computers/Tablets & Networking:Keyboards, Mice & Pointers:Mice, Trackballs & Touchpads
descriptionText: The Logitech M215 2.4GHz Wireless Optical Mouse is a sleek and efficient mouse designed for use with PC laptops. With a maximum DPI of 1000, this mouse offers precise and smooth cursor movement. It features a comfortable grip, a scroll wheel, and an on/off switch for added convenience. The mouse does not come with a USB receiver, but it does support wireless connectivity via USB. The optical tracking method ensures accurate and reliable cursor control, making it an ideal choice for everyday use.
